title: T-1 cache-aside helper reads local first falls back to origin and writes back with elicited TTL floor 1 second
description: T-1 cache-aside helper wraps a domain-origin call with the facade. getOr(key, originFn, {ttl}) reads local first via facade.get; on hit returns the cached value with source cache; on miss invokes originFn, writes back through facade.put with the effective TTL (elicited default 60 seconds per ADR-3202; floor 1 second enforced at this seam; no upper ceiling per Cloudflare KV documented per-namespace limits at https://developers.cloudflare.com/kv/platform/limits/), and returns the fresh value with source origin.
